free_tier.stated: KVM-MINI-NVMe at 139 RUB/month: 1 core, 768 MB RAM, 7 GB NVMe, channel up to 100 Mb/s, up to 8 IPv4, Moscow. The KVM-1-NVMe plan is 249 RUB/month with 1 GB and 20 GB, and the KVM SSD line starts at 199 RUB/month with 1 GB, 20 GB and a 100 Mb/s channel. The tracker quotes 139 RUB/month for the same KVM-MINI plan. The page publishes prepay discounts of 2 percent at 3 months, 5 percent at 6 months and 10 percent at 12 months; no annual plan price and no renewal price are printed. The card carries an order button and shows no out-of-stock notice.

record.notes: Two disagreements with the tracker, both recorded: the tracker says a 0.2 Gbps port while the vendor card says up to 100 Mb/s, and the tracker's 10,240 GB monthly figure does not appear on the vendor card, whose traffic field renders with no value. The site is Russian-language and prices are in roubles with a RUB/EUR/USD display switch that was left on RUB. Unverified: the traffic allowance, which needs the plan's tooltip or the terms page rather than the card. Rendering and provenance: currency symbols are written out (EUR, GBP, RUB, VND), diacritics in place names are folded to ASCII, and a price the page splits across two lines is joined as value/period; the tracker page stated 'Database update: 7 hours ago' when it was read on 2026-10-22.
